digest.component_or_area: Jira reconciler adapters (jira_family shared seam + jira_datacenter backend)
propositions: rebar cannot reconcile against self-hosted Jira Data Center, which differs from Cloud on REST v2 wiki-markup bodies, PAT bearer auth, and name-based user identity.
DC support must be delivered as an explicit shared jira_family sub-seam with a machine-checked import contract rather than a forked second adapter that reaches into jira/ privates.
The local-to-Jira status and priority maps are duplicated across three copies that have drifted (only ACLI omits deleted->Done); the two adapters/ copies must be consolidated to one definition.

Location-pinned modules (adf.py, outbound_fields.py, comment_limits.py) must not be relocated and _loader.py must stay untouched; they are shared by dependency inversion and contract parameterization.
The DC backend must require https for base_url unless allow_insecure=true (logging a warning), never disable certificate verification, and read the PAT only from the JIRA_PAT env var.

The headline acceptance criterion requires live operator-attested proof that an issue created in DC appears locally (inbound, now proven) and a local edit appears on the DC issue (outbound, still unproven).
